reference_protocol: DiffSBDD-style pocket-conditioned scaffold elaboration; single-site extension, not exact paper reproduction
primary_subset: R-heavy-count 2..10; exclude 1RVX uniformly because historical FLOWR preprocessing does not support that input
partition: One connected non-Murcko component cut at one non-ring SINGLE bond; retain all other atoms
cross_bond: exactly one SINGLE at declared anchor
size: exact removed R heavy atom count, assessed as output for models without native size control
chemistry_and_geometry: strict audit plus complete frozen PoseBusters dock checks
valid_new: strict and full geometry and successful scoring and different from reference
pose: raw generated heavy-atom coordinates; H-only common preparation; no heavy-atom minimization or redocking
budget: failed and duplicate raw attempts retained; no best-of-K or success-based replenishment
aggregation: per case and equal target-group weight; generated outputs are not independent target replicates
unique_counts: per-case chemical identities reported separately from raw successful attempts
serialization: native RDKit AllProps and CoordsAsDouble before copied SDF export
historical_output_compatibility: new archive layout; do not mix with historical results without an explicit migration
